Create an image following the given description: 
EXTREME WIDE SHOT. The skeletal canyon of decaying skyscrapers in Neo-Veridia is visible against a toxic amber sky. Broken neon signs flicker erratically, projecting toxic magenta and green light across the scene. A small, dark figure, characterized by a tattered black cloak, stands still in the center of a cracked ferrocrete street, positioned precisely at the intersection of Rigel and 4th Sector, sharply framed by the harsh, contrasting shadows of the flickering neon. The small, dark figure should reference Image 0 for appearance, including the tattered black cloak and the glowing sword, which is held down by their side.
